propositions: A runaway/exhaustion-truncated completion-verifier run disposes as exit 1 (blocking FAIL) instead of exit 11 (retryable fault), requiring --force to proceed.
Seam A: _restamp_marker pops the insufficiency marker from an un-banked (truncated) criterion where entry is None, yielding bare met=false indistinguishable from genuine refutation.

Seam B: reconcile_verdict sets evidence_sufficient=False on insufficiency-only FAIL but does not set verdict_obtainable=False, so close_precheck and verify-completion take hard-block exit 1 instead of retryable exit 11.
Fix A: condition _restamp_marker to stamp evidence_sufficient=False when entry is None (un-evaluated/truncated) or when _entry_insufficient(entry) is true, leaving present markerless entries bare.

Fix B: introduce shared helper completion_fail_returncode(result) returning exit 11 when verdict_obtainable is False OR evidence_sufficient is False, else exit 1, called by both close gate and verify-completion verb.
Deterministic regression tests (no LLM) confirm insufficiency-only FAIL→exit 11, genuine refutation→exit 1, and pre-existing no-criterion fault→exit 11 remain unaffected.
